Argentina has a current 2026 ANMAT notice explaining that under Disposition 64/2025, software with the manufacturer’s intended medical use for diagnosis, prevention, treatment or mitigation of a specific condition may be SaMD, including qualifying mobile apps, and must undergo the relevant authorization process. Law 25,326 identifies health information as sensitive and Article 12 restricts transfers to destinations without adequate protection; map hosting, analytics, external resources and all other flows before review. The 2023 data-protection bill appears as an update initiative on AAIP pages, not as current law; confirm any later legislative action rather than relying on the proposal. Law 26,653 applies to specified public bodies, public-service contractors and civil-society organizations receiving public support; whether its scope reaches a future operator is unassessed. Argentina’s emergency page distinguishes nationwide 911 from 107 ambulance service limited to Buenos Aires City and some Buenos Aires localities. Keep emergency text generic until local review. Federal, provincial, CABA and municipal applicability remains open.

countryRecords.sourceDiscoveryNote: Official-source discovery only; not legal advice, not a completeness claim, and not a determination of applicability. Kenya remains blocked; all 14 legal review areas, the national review and all 47 county targets remain not-assessed. The Data Protection Act and General Regulations plus ODPC health-data, children, DPIA and cross-border guidance need application to actual appointment-note/device-storage flows, controller roles, notice, rights, security and hosting. PPB published a Medical Device Software guideline in April 2026; assess intended purpose, functionality, claims and distribution with Kenyan regulatory counsel. Ministry materials list digital-health application, data-exchange and health-information regulations as drafts; verify final gazetting and commencement. The Persons with Disabilities Act 2025 replaced the 2003 Act and includes accessible communication; review its reach to a digital information service and test with disabled survivors/carers. Keep adult audience clear; review child protections before serving minors. The PBO Act commenced on 14 May 2024 and is consolidated to June 2025; review current registration and funding rules plus KRA charitable tax/donation rules before forming an entity or accepting funds. Kenya Police lists 999, 112 and 911 as hotlines, which does not establish ambulance reach in all locations; keep generic emergency wording pending local verification. County health and local requirements, municipal/subcounty rules, language, source rights, platform policies and all actual territorial/applicability questions remain open.

countryRecords.sourceDiscoveryNote: Federal and state source discovery only; not legal advice, a complete applicability screen, or permission to distribute. The 50 states and District of Columbia remain queued as 51 not-assessed review targets; US release remains blocked. Current federal leads include FTC health-app and Health Breach Notification Rule guidance, HIPAA role boundaries, FDA medical-software guidance, COPPA, ADA web accessibility and the HHS Section 504 digital-accessibility framework. The DOJ reports a 2026 extension to certain Title II public-entity compliance dates; HHS separately extended Section 504 dates for recipients of HHS financial assistance. Neither settles this project's applicability. Additional state health/privacy leads now include California CMIA, Connecticut Data Privacy and Security Act, Texas Health and Safety Code Chapter 181, Washington My Health My Data Act and Nevada consumer-health-data rules. This is a selected set, not a complete list: state comprehensive privacy statutes, health-specific laws, breach notification, consumer, accessibility, child, professional-practice, charity/fundraising and local rules still require a state-by-state review. The NCSL consumer privacy bill database can aid discovery but is not a substitute for current enacted law. Territories, tribal jurisdictions, counties, municipalities, actual hosting/data flows, operator identity, funding and platform requirements remain open. Generic emergency wording remains until local emergency routes are verified.

notes: This is a comprehensive discovery queue for the recorded M49 set and intended market supplements, not a completed legal register or legal opinion.
Every listed country or area remains not assessed and blocked from release.

The UN M49 list is maintained for statistical use and does not determine territorial status or legal jurisdiction. Separately scoped market supplements are identified as such and do not alter the M49 row set.

The 248 UN M49 identifiers have been cross-checked against the official M49 Overview ISO crosswalk. Supplemental market records are screened separately; review all codes and names against the current ISO Online Browsing Platform, identify applicable subnational laws, and obtain qualified local review before launch.

isoCodeCrosswalk.method: Matched the 248 standard M49 records by M49 and ISO alpha-3 codes to the official English M49 Overview table and recorded their ISO alpha-2 codes; separately scoped market supplements are not counted as M49 matches.
isoCodeCrosswalk.limit: Identifier reconciliation for standard M49 country-or-area rows only. The M49 FAQ says Taiwan is not separately shown and that 158 may be used only for strict statistical purposes; no legal applicability, territorial status, country-name scope, subnational law, or release status was assessed.
